title: Signature UI, E-signed badge and request-signature tracker
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; A-20 and A-31 work on a real signed document, in all four theme/control combinations
notes: Shell half of the signing pair per ADR 0012; opens only after the T-0241 library is verified and its claim is released. Serves acceptance items A-20 (signature with an E-signed badge only when the cryptographic check passes on an unmodified document), A-31 (request signature by email with a tracker that updates on import of the signed copy) and A-25 (place drawn/typed/image signature appearances) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Two rounds. Round 1: place drawn, typed and image signature appearances and certificate signatures on the page, calling the T-0241 signing API, plus a signature panel that shows the verification result. Round 2: the E-signed badge gated on a passing digest of an unmodified document, the request-signature email flow and the tracker list. Calls the library and does not change its semantics. The signing feature-matrix rows become `verified` only when this task lands; until then they stay `library` after T-0241. The app lane runs one task at a time, so earlier app tasks are implicit ordering constraints, not formal dependencies. Badge rule: A-20 badges a signature only when the digest check passes on an unmodified document; chain and identity status are shown separately and honestly, and when no trust anchor exists the UI says "identity not verified" instead of implying a trusted signer. A-31 request signature prepares a copy with an empty signature field, hands it to the default mail client as an attachment (Simple MAPI; fallback reveals the file for manual attachment), keeps a local tracker, imports the returned signed copy, validates it and raises a notification.
